description: Show every calling rule Call Desk holds for one US state, DC, territory or Canadian province: its time zones and area codes, federal and state calling-hours rules with windows, holidays and per-day call caps, recording consent, AI disclosure and automated message rules, each with citation, quote, source URL and as-of date, plus any rule we looked for and could not verify. With no state, returns a table of every jurisdiction with hours stricter than federal, the states with no stricter rule, and the all-party recording states. Informational, not legal advice.

state.description: A US state, DC, territory or Canadian province, as a code (OK) or name (Oklahoma). Leave out for the overview.
